Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday and I'm the technical lead evaluating inference platforms for a patient triage feature we're building. Would love a short demo to see the runtime, latency/cost controls, and privacy options. High-level details: 
- Use case: low-latency clinical triage + structured outputs for downstream EHR ingestion
- Volume: ~2k inference requests/day during pilot, expect to scale to ~150k/day in production next 12 months
- Timeline: pilot by Q4, production H1 next year

Key questions we want covered in the demo: model compatibility & version pinning, on-prem/private deployment options, data residency, and typical p95 latencies for similar workloads.

I'm in PST; available next Wed/Thu afternoons.
